label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koepka Withdraws
items.text: Brooks Koepka withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge after a three-week stretch, forfeiting a spot in the Memorial but committing to future events including the RBC Canadian Open.

items.headline: Aaron Rai Enters Memorial
items.text: Aaron Rai, fresh off winning the PGA Championship at Aronimink, is confirmed to play at the 2026 Memorial Tournament following a closing 65 with notable long putts.

items.headline: Clark’s 60 Wins Byron Nelson
items.text: Wyndham Clark shot an 11-under 60 to finish 30-under 254 and win the CJ Cup Byron Nelson by three shots over Si Woo Kim, marking his fifth PGA Tour victory.
